authorization:
사용자 원문: 그래 한 50개 만들고 전부 통과시켜
신규50종의 기술/독립 시각 검수 통과를 위해 지적 좌표를 실제로 교정하고, 이후 사용자 위임으로 Allow한다. 검수 결과를 꾸미지 않고 기존 판정을 보존한다.

issues.message: The upper distal foreleg is a blunt green paddle, and the lower tip around (45,40) has the same rounded treatment. Shape both into tapered inward-facing hooks with a clear inner cutting edge and elbow separation, retaining their connected arm roots. Carry this blade anatomy consistently through the other poses.

The lower foreleg becomes a broad horizontal oval while the upper one stretches diagonally upward; their cutting edges remain separated and do not communicate scissors closure. Redraw the two connected hooked blades into a readable converging or crossing contact silhouette, preserving the shoulder and elbow chain.

Turquoise effect pixels run through the inner upper foreleg, making the physical blade end ambiguous; the lower origin around (44,35) is also difficult to distinguish from the blade. Preserve two clearly readable scythe tips and originate one short tapered leaf projectile at each actual tip. Shorten the long luminous ribbons so the release reads as two leaf blades.

The lower foreleg has two adjacent green terminal clusters around (41,37) and (49,38), joined by branching contours. At 1x this suggests an extra blade or an unremoved previous position. Consolidate these into one connected recovering foreleg with one tip; express returning leaves with the turquoise effect palette instead of duplicate body-colored limb clusters.

The thin far support leg and its foot lose most of their separation against the dark preview background. Add a restrained existing mid-green rim along exposed knee, shin and foot pixels while keeping the underside dark; apply the same separation to corresponding far legs in the standing poses.
